Scheme for Boys Hostels
*481. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minsiter of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as epr the
Annual Reprot of his Minsitry for the year
2000-2001, a sum of Rs. 10.80 crore was
allocated for the Scheme for Boys Hostels
for the year 2000-2001 out of which only
Rs. 32 lakhs ahve been spent;
(b) if so, the reasons for such a large
amount remaining unspent; and
(c) the steps Government ahve taken to
ensure that such situations do not arise in
future and the amount allocated for a
particular scheme is utilised to the fullest
spread over the year?
Fly-lovers in Delhi
*482. SHRI B.P. SINGHAL: Will the
Minsiter of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of fly-overs which
are in operation in Delhi;
(b) the names of the companies which
ahve constructed these fly-oers;
(c) the details of the total time taken for
the construction of each fly-over;
(d) the details of the estimated cost and
the actual cost incurred on each fly-over;
and

proposed fly-overs in Delhi and the time-
frame within which there will be completed?
Pendency in cases due to lack of funds
*483. SHRI K. KALAVENKARA
RAO: Will the Minsiter of LAW, JUSTICE
AND COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether State Governments have
been blamed for penency for cases in courts
because sufficient funds were not made
avaialble by State Governments for smooth
functioning of the judiciary;
(b) the ratio of High Court Judges per
million of population at present;
(c) whether the Law Commission in one
of its reprots has recommended to increase
the nubmer of Judges per million of
population; and
(d) if so, the decision of Government in
this regard?

Privatization of profit earning PSUs
3481. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the profit earning Public
Sector Undertakings which have been
privatized, so far, giving the details of funds
realised from each;
(b) in what manner the funds so realised
were utilized; and
(c) the reasons for privatizing the profit
earning units?
Bids for sale of ITDC hotels
3482. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have invited
bids for sale of ITDC hotels;
(b) if so, the details of these hotels;
(c) the minimum net worth criteria for
bidders of the two Delhi hotels and others;
(d) the profit/loss incurred by these hotels
per annum during the last five years; and
(e) the guidelines laid down for sale of
profit earning units?
Dropping of Hotel Ashok and Janpath
from the list of disinvestment
3483. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to drop Hotel Ashok and Hotel
Janpath from the list of India Tourism
Development Corporation Limited (ITDC)
hotels that would be divested in the current
financial year;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government would float
tenders for other Delhi-based hotels of
ITDC shortly; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

contemplating pumping in Rs. 5,000 crore
to be invested in next five years; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:

be pleased to state:
(a) whether Suzuki Motor Corporation
of Japan and Government have finalised
the pricing of the shares for proposed rights
issue in their joint venture Maruti Udyog
Limited;

3488. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Chairman of a
French Aluminium giant has expressed
interest for holding a stake in NALCO;
(b) the recommendations of
Disinvestment Commission in respect of
selling NALCO's shareholding to
international investors;
(c) the percentage of shareholding of
Government in NALCO; and
(d) who are the other groups of
shareholders?
